d: Bitzer tries to lend a hand with some DIY but ends up in a very compromised situation.

Oswald finally lands an interview on a famous Odd Squad podcast to talk about the new Mobile Unit van, but he's only familiar with the main floor. In an attempt to learn more, Oswald gets lost and risks missing his interview.

On the way to deliver a baby blob to The Big O in London, the Mobile Unit van runs out of fuel. The team must refuel quickly, before the baby blob's big brother completely blobs London as it searches for its little brother.
ABC Kids programs resume at 4.00am
The Teletubbies hear a 'honk honk' in the distance and the Tubby Car approaches. The Tubby Car drives the Teletubbies across Teletubbyland as they sing the Tubby Car song.
Ariel runs a petting zoo. A new kid won't take turns.

At school, Teacher Harriet shows the class what to do to stay safe during a fire drill. While Daniel and his friends are playing, the fire alarm starts to ring, and the class practises their fire drill.
While helping Mum sort through some of the postcards on the fridge, Maddie + Triggs are transported to magical places as they wonder where oh where can Uncle George be?

Lucy and her dad are having a quiet, relaxing day boating on the lake. They fish out an old glittery mirror from the bottom of the lake and decide to keep it. Unfortunately the mirror belongs to a mermaid who needs it back.

Valerie Bertinelli and Duff Goldman ask the bakers to combine a lot of small parts to create one big whole by making cosmic cupcake pull-aparts decorated to look like the sun, a rocket, Saturn, a comet or the moon.
Fire and Fury are in the Ring, Sabre clings on in Hang Tough, and there are two epic Eliminators.

t: Are You Afraid of the Dark?
d: The Midnight Society seeks help from an unlikely source - the ghost of someone who may how the curse was created a generation earlier.

Jessica and Lewis are thrilled beyond belief when a Chinese family moves into the neighbourhood. Eddie and Emery decide to impersonate being census takers so they can find out when the owners of a pool are out of the house.

Louis attempts to teach Eddie how to be a good driver after a police officer makes an inappropriate comment about Asian drivers. Meanwhile, Evan learns that Emery has been hanging out with Grandma at her new garage apartment.
Meemaw gets assigned a tough probation officer and Georgie takes marriage advice from his father-in-law.
Mrs. Wicket is selling up and moving on - what will happen to Mr. Bean?
Mr. Bean's pizzas are a huge success with everyone - well almost everyone.
Mr Bean needs a new passport photograph and goes to incredible lengths to get one.
BTN High breaks down the week's biggest news stories for Aussie high schoolers.
Ash and friends meet up with Fortree Gym Leader Winona at the Feather Carnival.
Zeno demands to meet with Goku and asks him for something very odd. Meanwhile in the 10th Universe, Zamasu's hatred for humans grows.

t: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
d: As Marinette thinks about her future, a supervillain shows up in Paris. Able to force people to live their childhood dreams, he turns into a nightmare for our heroes.
Nom Nom is ordered by his doctor to take a vacation.
Raven chooses to hang out with Rose Wilson, a cool criminal.
In order to be the most talented superhero team in the DC universe, Robin and Beast Boy must work together on a jazz performance.
Izzy, convinced that Cody is an alien, embarks on a journey through space to take him back home.
It's the first day of term at Malory Towers and new girl Darrell Rivers can't wait for a fresh start! But whilst she's keen to settle in, will her past come back to haunt her?
From warring brothers to farting mothers, Horrible Histories presents some of the biggest, best and worst rivalries throughout time.
Legendary artists Da Vinci and Michelangelo are the guides for a journey through one of history's most creative, and sometimes weirdest, periods.
Shaun fakes sickness to have a day off in his secret den, but things don't go to plan when one by one, the rest of the flock join the ruse, making Bitzer suspicious.

On the way to deliver a baby blob to The Big O in London, the Mobile Unit van runs out of fuel. The team must refuel quickly, before the baby blob's big brother completely blobs London as it searches for its little brother.

Omar has plans to surprise Orla with a 500th birthday party. But due to some intense Odd Squad history, normal party gifts aren't going to fare well with her, so Oswald and Omar must track down the ideal birthday presents.
ABC Kids programs resume at 4.00am
The Teletubbies are about to go on the Tubby Custard Ride with the hat, bag, ball, and scooter when they realise there is not enough room. The Noo-noo looks after their things.
An adventure with Nana Xola. Remy gets big feelings.

Daniel and Mum Tiger are making a yummy breakfast at home when a mug falls and shatters. Daniel is about to help pick up the pieces, but his mum tells him to stop and listen to stay safe while she cleans up.
While out for an afternoon stroll with Granny, Maddie + Triggs discover an old bell tower and are surprised to hear a friendly voice welcoming them inside.

Daisy and Poppy and their toddler friends are taken on a trip to the big museum by their teacher Mrs Fotheringill. The naughty toddlers cause chaos and before too long Mrs Fotheringill, has been zapped back to the stone-age.
The Masquerade Ball reveals everyone's true colours. An enemy within forces Gabriel to question everything. Caspian's plan starts to unravel, putting Penelope in grave danger.

t: Are You Afraid of the Dark?
d: With dark forces growing stronger and the curse claiming another victim, a shattered Midnight Society prepares to fight back against the Shadowman.
Steve Backshall is headed for the crocodile infested waterways of South Africa to show us just what makes them so deadly.
The MythBusters drop into the science of falling, finding out if a skydiver can streamline like Keanu in Point Break; if a penny dropped from the Empire State Building could kill you; and more.

t: The Slow Mo Guys' Big Adventures
d: This time The Slow Mo Guys go yee hah! and look at the amazing world of the Wild West. How fast does a whip crack?

Competing through brutal group battles and fierce head-to-heads for a place in the heat final are Aftershock, Nuts 2, Jellyfish, Rapid, Sabretooth, TMHWK, Terrorhurtz and Crank-E. Let battle commence!
George Sr. is worried that Mary wants another baby and gets a vasectomy behind her back. Meanwhile, Drs. Linkletter and Sturgis go to Sheldon for science tutoring.
BTN High breaks down the week's biggest news stories for Aussie high schoolers.
It's Swellow versus Swellow as Ash and Winona battle it out in the Fortree City Gym!

Future Trunks, Vegeta and Goku finally use the time machine with intention to confront Black. But when they arrive, they're greeted by a familiar face and an unfamiliar power. Will they be able to stand up to this new threat?

t: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
d: A relative of Marinette's is akumatized into Simpleman, a supervillain determined to simplify this overly complex world. Stopping him won't be simple for Ladybug and Cat Noir!
The Bears allow bees to live in the cave to make honey.
Robin teaches the Titans how to play soccer and become obsessed.
The elderly Titans of the future decide to take one last trip to the 80s Retro world of Night Begins to Shine only to encounter a new villain ruling the land, Ultralak.
Chef accidentally cooks up a killer cyborg turkey in a failed attempt to get the kids to appreciate him on Appreciation Day.
The Professor's latest experiment goes awry.

Finn and Jake are on a noble quest to find the crystal apple when they are joined by an elephant, Tree Trunks. Finn doesn't think she has what it takes to be a hero, but he will see that heroes come in all shapes and sizes.
Jealous Gwen is determined to find out more about Darrell's past and leaves the school in pursuit of the truth - will Darrell be able to find her before her secret is revealed?

Felicity is keen to drop the 'mini-Rivers' nickname and become her own Malory success, but when she befriends a feisty new second-former, Josephine Jones, it isn't long before they start getting into trouble!
Ezra is outraged when everyone's treat day lunch orders are replaced with healthy food and insists on tracking down the culprit.
All Bitzer wants to do is see a shooting star. But he keeps missing them thanks to Shaun's antics.
While solving oddness on a farm, the team meets a kid named Jeremy, who is their biggest fan. Opal really wants to shine in front of him, but the team accidentally gets locked out of their van.
ABC Kids programs resume at 4.00am
The Teletubbies enjoy doing 'Round and Round the Garden', especially the end of the rhyme where they all tickle each other. The Tiddlytubbies have tickly fun too.
Fernie seeks seahorse unicorns. Ursula creates a game.

Daniel is SO excited for the new Tigey the Adventure Tiger book to come out, but before he can get it, he has to go to Dr. Plat's office. Waiting can be hard, but playing and imagining make the waiting go faster.
While watching TV, Maddie + Triggs keep annoying each other with their noisy snacking! But luckily Dad is on hand to help them remember the things they like about each other.
Ben and Holly want to play with Gaston the ladybird but he is missing. Nanny Plum uses her magic crystal ball to retrace Gaston's steps and find his whereabouts.
The Ninja learn more about the Krux and Acronix - the two fallen Elemental Masters known as the Hands of Time - and are sure that this threat has finally been eliminated.
Following the passing of a loved one, Sheldon navigates an uncharted territory, grappling with newfound responsibilities and emotional turmoil.
Find out what's going on in the world with a news bulletin designed for children, featuring stories that are relevant and easy to understand.

For 9 year old Sheldon Cooper it isn't easy growing up in Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king.
The tiger cubs are growing fast but one youngster is fighting with his family - it's normal behaviour, but the keepers must act fast to prevent serious injuries.
To win Tom Gleeson's Big Brass Mug, an eclectic collection of young experts are grilled on their knowledge of One Piece, the Irwins, The Baby-Sitters Club, and Electric Light Orchestra!

When Merlin and Arthur find themselves vastly outnumbered in a tavern brawl, an enigmatic man helps them to victory. The stranger risks his life to protect the prince, and is seriously wounded in the process.

Jessica raises concerns about Eddie's substitute teacher's progressive teaching methods, Louis and Honey look for a workout group to help them lose weight, and Emery doubts Evan's ability to pluck a splinter from his finger.
George Sr. gets an exciting job offer, and Sheldon prepares for his move to California.
Mr Bean needs to learn to dance to impress his girlfriend Irma.
Mr Bean is locked in a department store overnight and has the time of his life.
A movie fan travels from town to town, showing films to people who wouldn't otherwise have the chance to witness the cinema.
With Vegeta out of the fight, Goku and Future Trunks must fight Future Zamasu and Black with a man down. But can they hope to defeat an opponent who brushes off even the strongest attacks?

t: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
d: Because of one of Marinette's careless mistakes, one of her closest relatives is akumatized into Qilin, a fearsome supervillain. Will Ladybug dare to fight her?
The Bears spend a day at the park.
The Gang helps British secret agent Jenny Vex stop an evil mercenary from killing breakfast.
Beast Boy and his brain agree to take up gardening.
In order to stop Ultralak, the Titans must find three music stems, but will need help from a local Miner to get the first stem away from the Sheriff.

Owen wants his favourite treat, 'Jiggle Giggle', so bad that he's willing to use a time machine to get to snack time quicker. But when he ends up stuck in the past, Owen must decide between getting home and getting fed.
When Morbucks loses her money, Blossom tries to reform her.
When Princess Bubblegum tells Finn about "The Enchridion" a book for heroes, they embark on another noble quest to find the book. But they are tested time and time again.
Darrell starts helping Alicia to play pranks in class, whilst a mysterious red handprint appears on the door of the dormitory - could it be from the ghost of Lady Jane Malory?
When a demanding Gwen pushes monitor duties too far, June takes drastic action to support Clarissa... but will her radical plan pay off?
Maudie is upset when Ezra, Ava, and Kyle promote their new intern to an Inbestigator after he surprisingly solves a case before Maudie.

A newly installed doorbell camera records what happens when the Farmer accidentally locks himself out of the house. Bitzer tries to help him get back inside while simultaneously shielding him from Shaun's hi-jinks.

The Mobile Unit gets called back to the Museum of Natural Odd when Oswald's replacement, Ortho, has gone radio silent. When they arrive to find an ancient stone warrior let loose, they must de-code Ortho's numbering system.
ABC Kids programs resume at 4.00am
The Teletubbies travel by Tubby Car to the Hidey Hup where they all spin around on the Tubby Spinny.
Flounder helps Chef Louis. Flounder is Super Flounder.
Daniel is excited to play at the playground, but first they need to go to the store to get new shoes for Margaret. It can be very hard to wait, but Daniel learns to sing and imagine to pass the time.
While out hillwalking with Mum, Maddie + Triggs meet a new friend who teaches them all about yodelling - an ancient method of communicating over long distances.

The Elf Factory is deep down in the roots of The Great Elf Tree. It is almost Christmas time and the elves are busy making toys. When there is a problem with the toys a little bit of magic saves the day.

Kai's investigation of a Vermillion Warrior Helmet leads him to discover that Krux is alive and well in Ninjago, living under an assumed identity. Meanwhile, the Vermillion Warriors go on a kidnapping spree.

Meet 9-year-old Sheldon & his family! It isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king.
Find out what's going on in the world with a news bulletin designed for children, featuring stories that are relevant and easy to understand.
To appease his worried mother, Sheldon employs the techniques of a self-help book to try and make a friend.
The keepers have a challenge on their hands when one of their residents goes missing. How do you find an animal, amongst a million trees, that's perfectly camouflaged in the woods?
It's picture day! Valerie Bertinelli and Duff Goldman meet the 12 kid bakers through portrait cakes with an edible photo on top and custom emojis that show off each baker's hobbies.

When Merlin has an unexpected meeting with the mysterious Taliesin, the wizened old sorcerer takes the young warlock to the crystal cave and shows him a glimpse of the future. But this gift turns out to be more of a curse.
